name: Western: Location Interior
description: Image preset for a location interior in the Western look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an interior. List the room's purpose, three props that say who uses it, and the light source from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: interior view of the location from a doorway or corner, key furniture and props in place, light source visible, room for characters to stand, classic western film still, wide anamorphic frame, weathered faces, dust-caked leather and denim, sun-bleached timber, hard midday sun or golden-hour backlight, ochre and rust palette, long shadows, heat haze
negative_prompt: modern vehicles, power lines, clean clothes, neon, lush green forest, text, watermark
